description.tr: En büyük Osmanlı ansiklopedisti — Keşfü'z-Zünûn'u (14.500+ eser kataloğu) ve Cihannümâ'yı (Avrupa yöntemlerini kullanan ilk Osmanlı dünya coğrafyası) derledi || Kaynak materyali Kâtip Çelebi'yi 'en büyük Osmanlı ansiklopedisti' olarak adlandırır. || [Tarih notu] Flügel'in 1835-58 Keşfü'z-Zünûn edisyonu standart referans olmaya devam eder.
description.en: The greatest Ottoman encyclopedist — compiled Kashf al-Zunun (14,500+ works catalogued) and Cihannüma (first Ottoman world geography using European methods). Source material calls him 'the greatest Ottoman encyclopedist' || Source material explicitly calls Katip Çelebi 'the greatest Ottoman encyclopedist.' His Kashf al-Zunun catalogues 14,500+ works across all Islamic sciences. His Cihannüma was the first Ottoman geography to incorporate European cartographic advances (Mercator, Ortelius). Ibrahim Müteferrika later printed both works. || [Historiographical note] Flügel's 1835-58 edition of Kashf al-Zunun remains the standard reference. Gökyay (1977) established the intellectual context of Katip Çelebi's rationalist reformism.
